description: Lists ONZIP products an agent may pay for in USDC on Base via x402 v2. Prices are set in CAD (tax extra by the home's province). An order must first be opened by the signed-in landlord on the ONZIP web account page; the agent then pays that order's URL.
name: onzip_list_usdc_products
title: ONZIP — products payable in USDC
